tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Propose emailing an invoice to the customer. The recipients, subject, wording and attachments come from the organization and the customer's billing profile; nothing is chosen by you. A person always decides. Propose it after post_invoice when the customer is not sent invoices automatically.

invoiceId.description: The invoice, from list_invoices or post_invoice's proposal.

policy.rationale: Emails the customer their invoice; only a person sends it, to the recipients the customer's billing profile names.

tools.name: send_invoice_edi
tools.description: Propose sending a posted invoice to the customer's EDI partner as a 210. Set force only to resend one that already went, when the partner asks for it again. A person always decides.

force.description: Resend an invoice that was already sent by EDI.

invoiceId.description: The invoice, from list_invoices or get_invoice. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Transmits the invoice to the customer's EDI trading partner, which cannot be called back; only a person sends it.

tools.name: send_rate_confirmation
tools.description: Email a rate confirmation to the carrier, with a link to sign it while it is unsigned. The PDF goes to the carrier's contacts that receive rate confirmations, or the carrier's own address. The recipients come from the carrier's record and cannot be chosen here; fix the carrier's contacts first if they are wrong. Send a revision that is Generated, Sent (to send it again) or Confirmed (the executed copy); find it with list_rate_confirmations.

rateConfirmationId.description: The revision to send, from list_rate_confirmations.

policy.rationale: Emails a binding agreement, with a link to sign it, to a carrier outside the organization; the recipients come from the carrier's record, and a sent email cannot be recalled, so a person decides every send.

tools.name: set_accounting_mapping
tools.description: Choose which accounting system record a Trenova record or setting is sent as, and confirm it. Use an externalId from the mapping's candidates or from get_accounting_mapping's search options; never guess one. To accept Trenova's proposal, send the proposed record's externalId. Give a short reason a bookkeeper would accept. Only confirmed mappings are used when syncing.

externalId.description: The accounting system record's id, from get_accounting_mapping's candidates or search options.

key.description: The setting's key from list_accounting_mapping_gaps, for the other target types. Examples: "ARAccount", "Freight", "Net30", "ACH".

mappingId.description: The mapping's id from list_accounting_mapping_gaps or get_accounting_mapping. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why this record is the right one, in one sentence.

recordId.description: The Trenova customer, carrier or accessorial charge id, from list_customers, list_carriers or list_accessorial_charges.

targetType.description: The kind of Trenova record or setting, when naming it by recordId or key.

policy.rationale: Decides which account or record Trenova's invoices, payments and bills will post to, so a person approves it; clearing or changing it undoes it.

tools.name: set_carrier_monitoring
tools.description: Turn continuous monitoring on or off for carriers, so the provider reports authority, insurance and safety changes as they happen. Carriers without a DOT number are skipped.

enabled.description: True to monitor them, false to stop.

policy.rationale: Monitoring is billed per carrier by the provider; turning it off again undoes it, and nothing is sent to the carriers.

tools.name: set_field_value
tools.description: Set or correct the value of a field on the import page, such as the BOL, the weight, the pieces or the freight rate. Use it with the value the person gave you or one the document plainly shows; never make a value up.

fieldKey.description: The field's key exactly as the page draft lists it, such as rate or bol.

value.description: The value as the person would type it.

policy.rationale: Hands a change to the shipment the person is building on their own page; nothing is saved and nothing is sent.

tools.name: set_order_charge_allocations
tools.description: Replace how one order charge is split among payers without touching the charge itself. Percents must add up to 100 and amounts to the charge; an empty list bills it all to the order's customer.

amount.description: The share as an amount such as 250.00, when method is Amount.

billToCustomerId.description: The customer who pays this share, from list_customers. Never guess one.

method.description: Whether the share is a percent of the charge or a fixed amount.

percent.description: The share as a percent such as 60, when method is Percent.

chargeId.description: The order charge, from the charges get_order lists. Never guess one.

orderId.description: The order, from list_orders, get_order or the orderId get_shipment shows. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves who is billed for a charge; nothing is invoiced or sent, and the split is set back the same way until it is invoiced.

tools.name: set_recurring_shipment_status
tools.description: Pause a recurring shipment so it creates nothing, resume it (Active) from its next future slot without back-filling what it missed, or end it (Expired). A resumed series with no slot left ends on its own.

recurringShipmentId.description: The series, from list_recurring_shipments. Never guess one.

status.description: The status to set.

policy.rationale: Starts or stops a schedule inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the status is set back the same way.

tools.name: set_required_field
tools.description: Set the customer, service type, shipment type or rating method on the import page, by record id. Find the record first with list_customers, list_service_types, list_shipment_types or list_formula_templates, and set it once the person agrees; the page shows the record's own name.

field.description: Which of the four the record is for.

recordId.description: The record's id, from list_customers, list_service_types, list_shipment_types or list_formula_templates to match the field.

policy.rationale: Hands a change to the shipment the person is building on their own page; nothing is saved and nothing is sent.

tools.name: set_stop_location
tools.description: Match a stop on the import page to a location record. Find the location with list_locations by name, city or address; when none matches, create_location proposes a new one for the person to approve, and you set it once it exists.

locationId.description: The location's id, from list_locations or create_location.

stopIndex.description: The stop's number as the page draft lists it, counting from 0.

policy.rationale: Hands a change to the shipment the person is building on their own page; nothing is saved and nothing is sent.

tools.name: set_stop_schedule
tools.description: Set when a stop on the import page is scheduled: the start of its window and, optionally, the end. A time range the document shows without a date is not a schedule; ask the person for the date first.

stopIndex.description: The stop's number as the page draft lists it, counting from 0.

windowEnd.description: Optional: when the window closes, in the same form.

windowStart.description: The date and time the window opens, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the organization's time zone, or with an offset.

policy.rationale: Hands a change to the shipment the person is building on their own page; nothing is saved and nothing is sent.

tools.name: set_table_change_alert_status
tools.description: Pause one of the person's change alerts so it stops notifying them, or resume a paused one.

status.description: Paused stops its notices; Active resumes them.

tableChangeAlertId.description: The alert, from list_table_change_alerts. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Pauses or resumes an alert whose notices go to the person who owns it; the opposite call undoes it.

tools.name: set_worker_availability_preference
tools.description: Record whether a worker prefers, is available for or cannot work one weekday, as they told the office. The rota shows it beside their pattern; it does not change the pattern.

note.description: Why, in the worker's words where you have them.

preference.description: What the worker said about that day.

workerId.description: The driver, from search_worker or list_workers. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Records a worker's own stated preference inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is set again the same way.

tools.name: share_invoice
tools.description: Propose sharing an invoice with teammates, who get a notification and an email with your note and a link to it. Pick them with list_invoice_share_candidates, which lists only people who may read invoices. It is sent in the name of the person who approves it, so a person always decides.

invoiceId.description: The invoice, from list_invoices or get_invoice.

note.description: A note for them, such as what to look at.

tab.description: The part of the invoice the link opens on. Defaults to overview.

policy.rationale: Notifies and emails colleagues in the name of the person who shares it, with a note they read as theirs; only that person sends it.

tools.name: shop_carriers
tools.description: Price a saved shipment against carriers and rank them by contract cost, margin against the customer's charge, and routing guide rank. Leave the carrier list empty to use the shipment's routing guide. Read this before tendering; nothing is tendered or written by it.

carrierIds.description: An explicit shortlist of carrier ids from list_carriers. Empty means the routing guide's candidates.

limit.description: How many options to return; defaults to 5, at most 20.

shipmentId.description: The saved shipment to price, from search_shipments or list_shipments, or the page you are on.

strategy.description: How to rank the options. Defaults to the organization's own choice.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: skip_accounting_sync
tools.description: Mark one document as intentionally not sent to the accounting system, with the reason. Use it only when a person says the document must stay out of the books, for example because they already entered it by hand. A skipped document is never sent again, so the books will not have it unless someone enters it there. It cannot skip a document already sent or being sent.

reason.description: Why the document stays out of the books, in one sentence a bookkeeper would accept.

syncRecordId.description: The sync record's id, from list_accounting_sync_records or get_accounting_sync_record.

policy.rationale: Leaves a document out of the organization's books for good; nothing sends it again, so a person approves it.

tools.name: split_move_at_relay
tools.description: Split a two-stop move at its delivery stop so the freight is dropped there as a relay and a new move carries it on to a new delivery location. The relay pickup window and the new delivery window come from the person who asked or the customer's instructions, never from a guess: the move keeps its driver only as far as the relay. Only a New or Assigned pickup-to-delivery move splits.

moveId.description: The two-stop move to split, from get_shipment (its moves) or get_dispatch_board. Never guess one.

newDeliveryEnd.description: When the final delivery window closes. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

newDeliveryLocationId.description: Where the freight finally goes, from list_locations. It must differ from the current delivery location.

newDeliveryStart.description: When the final delivery window opens; after the relay pickup window. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

pieces.description: Pieces going on from the relay.

relayPickupEnd.description: When that relay pickup window closes. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

relayPickupStart.description: When the new move's pickup at the relay opens; after the current delivery window ends. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

weight.description: Weight going on from the relay.

policy.rationale: Adds a move and turns a delivery into a relay inside Trenova; the two new windows are times only a person can vouch for, so a person always approves it.

tools.name: start_performance_review
tools.description: Open a draft performance review for a worker from a review template. It covers a period, with the person who approves it as the reviewer. The template's items are copied on unrated; draft_performance_review fills them in. The worker sees nothing until the reviewer submits it.

periodEnd.description: The last day the review covers. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

periodStart.description: The first day the review covers. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

templateId.description: The review template, from list_performance_reviews. Never guess one.

title.description: A title; defaults to the template and period.

workerId.description: The driver, from search_worker or list_workers. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Opens a draft review inside Trenova; the worker sees nothing, and delete_performance_review removes the draft.

tools.name: start_settlement_dispute_review
tools.description: Move an open pay dispute a driver raised to under review, so the driver and the team see someone is looking into it. It decides nothing; resolve_settlement_dispute does.

disputeId.description: The pay dispute, from get_driver_settlement's openDisputes, get_settlement_dispute or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Marks the dispute as being worked inside Trenova; the driver sees its status in Dash, and resolving it moves it on.

tools.name: start_worker_checklist
tools.description: Start a checklist for a worker from one of the organization's hand-started templates, such as an annual file audit. Onboarding and offboarding checklists start from the hire or the termination and are refused here. A template already open for the worker is not started twice.

startedAt.description: The day it starts, which its items fall due from. Defaults to today. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

templateId.description: The template, from list_worker_checklists. Never guess one.

workerId.description: The driver, from search_worker or list_workers. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Opens a checklist on the worker inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and cancel_worker_checklist cancels it.

tools.name: submit_carrier_settlement
tools.description: Submit a draft carrier settlement for approval once its lines are right. It moves to pending approval, where a person approves it or sends it back. Read it with get_carrier_settlement first; one with exceptions should be fixed or explained before it goes.

settlementId.description: The carrier settlement, from list_carrier_settlements or get_carrier_settlement or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves a draft into the approval queue inside Trenova; nothing is paid and a reviewer sends it back to draft.

tools.name: submit_driver_settlement
tools.description: Submit a draft driver settlement for approval once its lines are right. It moves to pending approval, where a person approves it or sends it back. Read it with get_driver_settlement first; one with exceptions should be fixed or explained before it goes.

settlementId.description: The driver settlement, from list_driver_settlements or get_driver_settlement or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves a draft into the approval queue inside Trenova; nothing is paid and a reviewer sends it back to draft.

tools.name: submit_invoice_adjustment
tools.description: Propose crediting, rebilling, reversing or writing off posted invoices. Give adjustments, one per invoice and up to 25 at once, or draftAdjustmentId to submit a saved draft as it stands. Each executes at once or waits for approval as the organization's adjustment policy says. It creates credit memos and replacement invoices, so a person always decides.

adjustments.description: The adjustments to submit, one per invoice. Leave out when submitting a draft.

invoiceId.description: The posted invoice, from list_invoices or get_invoice.

kind.description: CreditOnly credits lines; CreditAndRebill credits them and reissues a corrected invoice; FullReversal credits the whole invoice; WriteOff writes an uncollectable balance off.

lines.description: The invoice lines to adjust. Leave out a line to leave it alone; leave out an amount to credit the whole of what is left on the line.

creditAmount.description: How much of the line to credit, as a decimal.

creditQuantity.description: The quantity credited, as a decimal.

description.description: The line's wording on the credit memo, when it should differ.

invoiceLineId.description: The line's id, from get_invoice's lines.

rebillAmount.description: The line's corrected amount on the reissued invoice, for a Manual rebill.

rebillQuantity.description: The line's corrected quantity on the reissued invoice.

reason.description: Why, as the customer or the biller would say it.

rebillStrategy.description: How a CreditAndRebill reissues: CloneExact copies the lines, Rerate prices them again, Manual takes the rebill amounts you give. Defaults to CloneExact.

supportingDocumentIds.description: Documents on the invoice's shipments that support it, from search_documents or get_shipment.

draftAdjustmentId.description: The draft adjustment, from list_invoice_adjustments or get_invoice_adjustment. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Credits, rebills or writes off receivables and books the entries that say so; only a person submits an adjustment, and the adjustment policy may still hold it for an approver.

tools.name: submit_manual_journal
tools.description: Submit a balanced draft manual journal for approval. It waits for an approver; where the organization has manual journal approval turned off, submitting approves it, so only a person does that. Read it with get_manual_journal first.

manualJournalId.description: The manual journal, from list_manual_journals or get_manual_journal. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves a draft journal into the approval queue inside Trenova; an approver decides and it books nothing until a person posts it.

tools.name: submit_rate_agreement
tools.description: Submit a draft rate agreement for review. It prices nothing until a person approves it. Read it with get_rate_agreement first.

comment.description: A note on the review for whoever reads the agreement next.

rateAgreementId.description: The rate agreement, from list_rate_agreements or get_rate_agreement. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves a draft agreement into review inside Trenova; it prices nothing until a person approves it.

tools.name: suspend_rate_agreement
tools.description: Propose suspending an active rate agreement, such as for a customer on credit hold, with the reason. Shipments stop rating against it at once; resume_rate_agreement puts it back. A person always decides.

comment.description: Why, in a sentence the agreement's owner can act on.

rateAgreementId.description: The rate agreement, from list_rate_agreements or get_rate_agreement. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Stops an agreement pricing shipments, which changes what customers are charged; only a person suspends one.

tools.name: tender_move_to_carriers
tools.description: Offer an uncovered move to specific carriers at specific rates: broadcast to all of them at once, or sequentially in the order given. Each line names the carrier, the rate and how it is measured (flat or per mile), how long the carrier has to accept, and how the offer is sent. Read shop_carriers first so the rates come from contracts rather than guesses; a rate you cannot source is a reason to raise an exception, not to invent one.

lines.description: One line per carrier, in the order they should be asked.

carrierId.description: The carrier, from shop_carriers or list_carriers.

email.description: Where to send an email offer, when not the carrier's own address.

offerTtlSeconds.description: How long the carrier has to accept. Defaults to the organization's setting.

rate.description: The offered rate as a decimal string.

rateMethod.description: How the rate is measured. Defaults to Flat.

mode.description: Broadcast asks every carrier at once; Sequential asks them in order.

overrideInsuranceWarnings.description: Offer to a carrier whose insurance is flagged anyway. Off by default.

shipmentMoveId.description: The move to tender, from get_dispatch_board (moveId) or get_shipment (its moves).

policy.rationale: Offers the load to carriers outside the organization.

tools.name: tender_move_to_routing_guide
tools.description: Offer an uncovered move to carriers down its routing guide, in the guide's order at the guide's rates. Each carrier gets the guide's time to accept before the next is asked. The guide is matched from the move's lane unless one is named. The move must have no driver and no live tender. Use shop_carriers first when the choice of carrier matters.

routingGuideId.description: A specific routing guide to use instead of the one matched from the lane: the routingGuideId shop_carriers returns. Omit to match from the lane.

shipmentMoveId.description: The move to tender, from get_dispatch_board (moveId) or get_shipment (its moves).

policy.rationale: Offers the load to carriers outside the organization.

tools.name: test_formula_expression
tools.description: Price a formula expression with Trenova's formula engine, for sample loads or against a saved shipment. Use it to check a formula runs and to learn what it charges; say an amount only when this or propose_formula gave it.

expression.description: The expression to price, such as the one in the page draft.

scenarios.description: Loads to price, each named and described in a sentence, with the variable values that make it that load.

description.description: One sentence.

name.description: A short name.

variables.description: Variable values for this load, by variable name.

schemaId.description: The formula schema, as the page draft names it; shipment when it names none.

shipmentId.description: Optional: price a saved shipment instead of sample loads, from list_shipments or search_shipments.

variables.description: Values for the formula's own variables, by name, used by every load unless a load sets its own.

policy.rationale: Prices an expression with the formula engine, for sample values or a shipment the caller may read; nothing is saved and nothing is sent.

tools.name: transfer_shipment_ownership
tools.description: Make another person the owner of a shipment, the one it is filed under and who is asked about it. Take the new owner from the person who asked or the ownerId get_shipment shows on another of the customer's shipments; never guess a user. Only the current owner or someone allowed to change the shipment may hand it on.

ownerId.description: The user who takes it over: the person who asked, or an ownerId get_shipment shows. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment, from get_shipment, search_shipments or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes who owns a shipment inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is transferred back the same way.

tools.name: transfer_to_billing
tools.description: Transfer delivered shipments to the billing queue, as the transfer-to-billing dialog does: each becomes a queue item a biller reviews. When the person means every shipment that can go (all of them, everything ready), set allTransferable to true, with the same filters list_billing_transfer_candidates takes, instead of copying ids: the proposal lists each shipment it resolves to. For a hand-picked set, give shipmentIds from list_billing_transfer_candidates. Cover every shipment in one call rather than one call per shipment; a shipment the checks refuse is reported, not transferred, and the rest still go. The person approving may untick shipments. Up to 100 transfer at once; more run as a background transfer.

allTransferable.description: True to transfer every shipment list_billing_transfer_candidates says would transfer, narrowed by query, status, customerId, deliveredFrom and deliveredTo. Use it instead of shipmentIds, never with them.

billType.description: What the queue items bill. Defaults to Invoice.

customerId.description: Only this customer's shipments, by id from list_customers.

deliveredFrom.description: Only shipments delivered on or after this day. A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today.

deliveredTo.description: Only shipments delivered on or before this day. A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today.

markCompletedReadyToInvoice.description: Mark Completed shipments ready to invoice first, as the dialog can. Defaults to false, which leaves a Completed shipment where it is.

query.description: Words matched against pro number, BOL and the other searchable columns, as the dialog's search box does.

shipmentIds.description: The shipments to transfer, by id from list_billing_transfer_candidates, when not allTransferable. Never guess one.

status.description: Only shipments in this status. Completed shipments transfer only when markCompletedReadyToInvoice is true.

policy.rationale: Hands delivered shipments to the billing queue inside Trenova, by the checks the transfer dialog makes; a biller, or the organization's own auto-approve rule, still decides every item.

tools.name: transition_item_to_in_review
tools.description: Move a blocked billing queue item into the InReview state so a biller can work it.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item to move to InReview: this run's subject, the record on the page, or one list_billing_queue_items found. Never guess one.

policy.condition: An item on hold was held there by a person or a rule, so moving one into review is a proposal a person decides; an item in any other state moves as far as the agent allows, and one that cannot be read waits for a person.
policy.rationale: Moves the run's billing queue item into review inside Trenova; nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.name: triage_bank_receipt_work_item
tools.description: Assign a bank receipt's reconciliation work item to a person who will work it, or mark it under review while it is being looked into. Nothing is matched or closed; match_bank_receipt and resolve_bank_receipt_work_item do that.

action.description: Assign hands it to a person; StartReview marks it under review.

assigneeUserId.description: For Assign: the person's user id, the assignedToUserId get_bank_receipt shows on a work item, or the person who asked. Never guess one.

workItemId.description: The work item's id, from get_bank_receipt or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes who works a reconciliation item and says it is being looked into; it moves no money and the item is reassigned the same way.

tools.name: unapply_credit_memo
tools.description: Propose taking back one credit memo application: the invoice it settled is reopened by that amount and the credit is available again. Use it when credit went to the wrong invoice. A person always decides; say why.

creditMemoApplicationId.description: The application, from list_credit_memo_applications. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why it is taken back.

policy.rationale: Reopens an invoice's balance and restores a customer's credit; only a person moves credit.

tools.name: unassign_moves
tools.description: Take the driver and equipment off one or more moves that have not started, leaving each uncovered for someone else. Use it when a driver can no longer run a load: the driver called off, broke down or ran out of hours before pickup. A move can be unassigned only while its assignment is fresh — assigned, not yet in transit; a move under way is not taken off its driver. The drivers are told the load was taken off them. Cover the move again with assign_move or a tender.

moveIds.description: The moves to take the driver off, by id from get_dispatch_board (moveId) or get_shipment (its moves). One move is the normal case.

policy.condition: Only one move at a time, still freshly assigned, is taken off its driver without a decision; several moves, a move the service would refuse and a move that cannot be read each wait for a person.
policy.rationale: Takes the driver off a move that has not started, inside Trenova; the driver is told the load was taken off them but sees no text the model wrote, and assigning the move again undoes it.

tools.name: uncancel_shipment
tools.description: Reopen a canceled shipment as New, with its moves and stops back to New, when the person says the freight is back on. Nothing is sent to the customer, a carrier or a trading partner, and nobody is assigned: tender or assign it again afterwards. Read it with get_shipment first to be sure it is the canceled one.

shipmentId.description: The canceled shipment, from get_shipment, search_shipments or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Puts a canceled shipment back to New inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and canceling it again undoes it.

tools.name: unlock_fiscal_period
tools.description: Propose unlocking a locked fiscal period so it is open again, when postings must still land in it before it closes. A person always decides.

fiscalPeriodId.description: The fiscal period, from list_fiscal_periods. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes which dates the ledger takes postings for; only a person unlocks a period.

tools.name: unpin_shipment_comment
tools.description: Take a pinned comment off the top of a shipment's thread once what it said no longer applies.

commentId.description: The comment, from the recentComments get_shipment lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the comment is on, from get_shipment, search_shipments or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Orders a shipment's own comment thread inside Trenova; pinning again undoes it and nothing is sent.

tools.name: update_carrier
tools.description: Change a carrier's details: name, numbers, SCAC, address, dispatch contact, notes, or payment and remit-to details. Fields left out keep their value. Use update_carrier_status to activate or retire it and vet_carrier for compliance.

addressLine1.description: The street address. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

addressLine2.description: Suite, building or unit. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

carrierId.description: The carrier to change, from list_carriers. Never guess one.

carrierType.description: What kind of carrier it is. Defaults to Common. Leave it out to keep it.

city.description: The city. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

code.description: The carrier's short code, unique in this organization. Leave it out to keep it.

dbaName.description: The name it does business as, when that differs. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

dotNumber.description: The USDOT number, digits only. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

email.description: The dispatch email address. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

is1099Eligible.description: Whether payments are reported on a 1099. Leave it out to keep it.

mcNumber.description: The MC docket number, digits only. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

name.description: The carrier's legal name. Leave it out to keep it.

notes.description: Anything colleagues booking this carrier should know. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

paymentMethod.description: How the carrier is paid. Defaults to Check. Payment details are only ever proposed and change on a person's approval. Leave it out to keep it.

paymentTermDays.description: Days after the invoice the carrier is paid. Defaults to 30. Leave it out to keep it.

phone.description: The dispatch phone number. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

postalCode.description: The ZIP code. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

remitAddressLine1.description: The remit-to street address. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

remitAddressLine2.description: The remit-to suite or unit. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

remitCity.description: The remit-to city. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

remitPostalCode.description: The remit-to ZIP code. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

remitState.description: The remit-to state. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

remitToName.description: Who payment is made out to. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

scac.description: The two to four letter SCAC. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

state.description: The state of the street address. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

taxId.description: The tax id payments are reported under. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

taxIdType.description: Whether the tax id is an EIN or an SSN; required with a tax id. Leave it out to keep it.

w9OnFile.description: Whether a signed W-9 is on file. Leave it out to keep it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a carrier inside Trenova and keeps its contacts, insurance and EDI channels; nothing is sent. A call that changes payment or remit-to details is money and runs only on a person's approval.

tools.name: update_carrier_status
tools.description: Set one or more carriers Active, Inactive or DoNotUse, which decides whether they can be tendered freight. Get the ids from list_carriers.

carrierIds.description: The carrier records to change, by id from list_carriers. One id is the normal case.

status.description: The status to set. Active carriers can be tendered freight; Inactive ones are kept on file; DoNotUse marks a carrier nobody may book.

policy.rationale: Changes whether carriers are offered for booking inside Trenova; nothing is sent.

tools.name: update_commodity
tools.description: Change a commodity: its name, description, freight class, temperature range, dimensions, handling or hazardous material. Fields left out keep their value. Use update_commodity_status to activate or retire it.

commodityId.description: The commodity to change, from list_commodities. Never guess one.

description.description: What the goods are. Leave it out to keep it.

fragile.description: Whether it is fragile. Leave it out to keep it.

freightClass.description: The NMFC freight class. Leave it out to keep it.

hazardousMaterialId.description: The hazardous material it is, from list_hazardous_materials, when the goods are hazmat. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

heightPerUnit.description: Inches high per unit. A decimal such as 42.5. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

lengthPerUnit.description: Inches long per unit. A decimal such as 42.5. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

linearFeetPerUnit.description: Linear feet of trailer per unit. A decimal such as 42.5. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

loadingInstructions.description: How it is loaded and secured. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

maxQuantityPerShipment.description: The most units one shipment may carry. A decimal such as 42.5. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

maxTemperature.description: The highest temperature it may be carried at, in degrees Fahrenheit. Leave it out to keep it.

minTemperature.description: The lowest temperature it may be carried at, in degrees Fahrenheit. Leave it out to keep it.

name.description: The commodity's name, unique in this organization. Leave it out to keep it.

stackable.description: Whether units may be stacked. Leave it out to keep it.

weightPerUnit.description: Pounds per unit. A decimal such as 42.5. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

widthPerUnit.description: Inches wide per unit. A decimal such as 42.5. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a commodity inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a later change puts it back.

tools.name: update_commodity_status
tools.description: Set one or more commodities Active or Inactive, which decides whether shipments can name them. Get the ids from list_commodities.

commodityIds.description: The commodity records to change, by id from list_commodities. One id is the normal case.

status.description: The status to set. Active records are offered when people book; Inactive ones are kept on file and no longer offered.

policy.rationale: Changes whether commodities are offered for booking inside Trenova; nothing is sent.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Change a customer's details: name, billing address, DOT and MC numbers, who is emailed status updates, and consolidation. Fields left out keep their value. Use update_customer_status to activate or retire it.

addressLine1.description: The billing street address. Leave it out to keep it.

addressLine2.description: Suite, building or unit. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

allowConsolidation.description: Whether its shipments may be consolidated. Leave it out to keep it.

city.description: The city. Leave it out to keep it.

code.description: The customer's short code, unique in this organization. Leave it out to keep it.

consolidationPriority.description: Its priority when shipments are consolidated, 1 first. Leave it out to keep it.

customerId.description: The customer to change, from list_customers. Never guess one.

dotNumber.description: The USDOT number, digits only, for a broker customer. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

exclusiveConsolidation.description: Whether its shipments are consolidated only with each other; needs allowConsolidation. Leave it out to keep it.

mcNumber.description: The MC docket number, digits only. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

name.description: The customer's name. Leave it out to keep it.

postalCode.description: The ZIP code. Leave it out to keep it.

state.description: The state. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX. Leave it out to keep it.

statusUpdatePreference.description: Which stop events the customer is emailed about. None stops the emails and clears the recipients. Changing who is emailed is only ever proposed. Leave it out to keep it.

statusUpdateRecipients.description: The addresses status updates go to, separated by commas. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a customer inside Trenova and leaves its billing and email profiles alone; nothing is sent. Changing who receives status emails is held for a person.

tools.name: update_customer_status
tools.description: Set one or more customers Active or Inactive, which decides whether shipments can be booked for them. Get the ids from list_customers.

customerIds.description: The customer records to change, by id from list_customers. One id is the normal case.

status.description: The status to set. Active records are offered when people book; Inactive ones are kept on file and no longer offered.

policy.rationale: Changes whether customers are offered for booking inside Trenova; nothing is sent.

tools.name: update_dot_random_selection
tools.description: Record where one random testing selection stands. Notified once the driver has been told to report, Excused with the reason when they cannot be tested this period, or Missed. A selection completes on its own when its test is recorded.

drawEntryId.description: The selection, from get_dot_random_draw. Never guess one.

excuseReason.description: For Excused: why, such as extended leave.

status.description: Notified, Excused or Missed.

policy.rationale: Updates a selection on a round inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the driver, and the selection is updated again the same way.

tools.name: update_employment_verification
tools.description: Correct a previous employer on the qualification file, or record their answer. The answer is when it came back, the accidents and drug and alcohol violations it reports, the findings and the document. Give only what changes, from the answer itself.

contactEmail.description: Their email address, as the application gives it.

contactPhone.description: Their phone number, as the application gives it.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from search_documents. Never guess one.

drugAlcoholResponseReceivedAt.description: When their drug and alcohol answer came back. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

employedFrom.description: When the worker started there. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

employedTo.description: When the worker left. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

findings.description: What the employer's answer says, from the document they sent.

hadDrugAlcoholViolations.description: Whether they reported a drug or alcohol violation.

notes.description: Anything the file should say.

responseReceivedAt.description: When the employer's answer came back. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

status.description: Where the request stands.

verificationId.description: The previous employer's verification, from list_employment_verifications. Never guess one.

wasDotRegulated.description: Whether the job was DOT-regulated, which brings the drug and alcohol questions in.

policy.rationale: Updates the previous employer's record in the qualification file inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: update_escrow_account
tools.description: Propose changing an escrow account's target balance or the interest it earns, as an amended lease sets them. The balance itself changes only through contributions and adjust_escrow_account. A person always decides.

accountId.description: The escrow account, from list_escrow_accounts. Never guess one.

annualInterestRate.description: The annual interest rate paid on the balance, as a percent such as 2.5.

targetAmount.description: The new target balance, as a decimal.

policy.rationale: Changes the escrow terms of an owner-operator's lease; only a person agrees them.

tools.name: update_hazardous_material
tools.description: Change a hazardous material: its class, UN number, packing group, shipping name, placarding, handling or emergency contact. Fields left out keep their value. Use update_hazardous_material_status to activate or retire it.

class.description: The DOT hazard class or division. Leave it out to keep it.

description.description: What the material is. Leave it out to keep it.

emergencyContact.description: Who to call in an emergency. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

emergencyContactPhoneNumber.description: The emergency response phone number. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

ergGuideNumber.description: The Emergency Response Guidebook guide number. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

handlingInstructions.description: How it is handled. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

hazardousMaterialId.description: The hazardous material to change, from list_hazardous_materials. Never guess one.

inhalationHazard.description: Whether it is a poison inhalation hazard. Leave it out to keep it.

isReportableQuantity.description: Whether it is a reportable quantity substance. Leave it out to keep it.

labelCodes.description: The label codes packages carry. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

marinePollutant.description: Whether it is a marine pollutant. Leave it out to keep it.

name.description: The material's name, unique in this organization. Leave it out to keep it.

packingGroup.description: The packing group: I is great danger, III minor. Leave it out to keep it.

placardRequired.description: Whether a vehicle carrying it must be placarded. Leave it out to keep it.

properShippingName.description: The proper shipping name from the hazardous materials table. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

quantityThreshold.description: The reportable quantity; required when isReportableQuantity. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

specialProvisions.description: The special provision codes, separated by commas. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

subsidiaryHazardClass.description: Any subsidiary hazard class. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

unNumber.description: The four-digit UN or NA number, without the prefix. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a hazardous material inside Trenova; nothing is sent. What drivers placard and who they call follows it, so a person approves every change.

tools.name: update_hazardous_material_status
tools.description: Set one or more hazardous materials Active or Inactive, which decides whether commodities can name them. Get the ids from list_hazardous_materials.

hazardousMaterialIds.description: The hazardous material records to change, by id from list_hazardous_materials. One id is the normal case.

status.description: The status to set. Active records are offered when people book; Inactive ones are kept on file and no longer offered.

policy.rationale: Changes whether hazardous materials are offered inside Trenova; nothing is sent.

tools.name: update_invoice_draft
tools.description: Change what a draft invoice says and where it goes: its memo, remittance instructions, email subject and body, recipients and attached documents. Only the fields you pass change; an empty string or list clears one. A posted invoice is changed with an invoice adjustment instead.

attachmentDocumentIds.description: The documents attached to the email, from search_documents; replaces the list.

emailBcc.description: Who is blind-copied; replaces the list.

emailBody.description: The body of the email the invoice goes in.

emailCc.description: Who is copied; replaces the list.

emailSubject.description: The subject of the email the invoice goes in.

emailTo.description: Who the invoice is emailed to; replaces the list.

invoiceId.description: The invoice, from list_invoices or get_invoice. Never guess one.

memo.description: The note printed on the invoice.

remittanceInstructions.description: How the customer should pay, printed on the invoice.

policy.condition: Changing who the invoice is emailed to is a proposal a person decides; any other change runs once a person approves it.
policy.taintHold: Outside content could put its own wording or recipients on an invoice the customer receives.
policy.rationale: Edits a draft nobody outside has seen; the customer sees it only when a person sends it, but the recipients decide where it goes then.

tools.name: update_leave_case
tools.description: Correct or fill in a leave case as it goes: the kind, how it is taken, the dates, hours worked for eligibility, a document, notes. Give only what changes. It never decides the case.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from search_documents. Never guess one.

eligibilityHoursWorked.description: Hours worked in the twelve months before, for eligibility.

endsAt.description: The last day of leave, when it is known. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

leaveCaseId.description: The leave case, from list_worker_leave_cases. Never guess one.

militaryCaregiver.description: Whether it is leave to care for a covered servicemember.

notes.description: Anything the case should say.

reason.description: Why, as the worker gave it. Keep medical detail out; the certification carries that.

startsAt.description: The first day of leave. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

policy.rationale: Corrects a leave case inside Trenova; nothing is decided or sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: update_leave_day
tools.description: Correct a day of leave already recorded: the hours, whether it counts against the entitlement, the time off it runs with, or its note. Give only what changes.

countsAgainstEntitlement.description: Whether this day counts against the FMLA entitlement.

hours.description: Hours taken that day, such as 8 or 4.5.

leaveDayId.description: The day of leave, from list_worker_leave_cases. Never guess one.

notes.description: The day's note.

ptoId.description: Paid time off booked for the same day, from list_time_off.

policy.rationale: Corrects a recorded day of leave inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: update_location
tools.description: Change a location's name, description, address or category. Fields left out keep their value, and its code never changes. Use update_location_status to activate or retire it.

addressLine1.description: The street address. Leave it out to keep it.

addressLine2.description: Suite, building or dock. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

city.description: The city. Leave it out to keep it.

description.description: Anything drivers and dispatchers should know about it. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

locationCategoryId.description: What kind of place it is, from list_location_categories. Leave it out to keep it.

locationId.description: The location to change, from list_locations. Never guess one.

name.description: The facility or company name at the address. Leave it out to keep it.

postalCode.description: The ZIP code. Leave it out to keep it.

state.description: The state. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX. Leave it out to keep it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a location inside Trenova; nothing is sent. Its address is often read from a document someone outside sent, so such a change is proposed.

tools.name: update_location_status
tools.description: Set one or more locations Active or Inactive, which decides whether stops can be booked at them. Get the ids from list_locations.

locationIds.description: The location records to change, by id from list_locations. One id is the normal case.

status.description: The status to set. Active records are offered when people book; Inactive ones are kept on file and no longer offered.

policy.rationale: Changes whether locations are offered for booking inside Trenova; nothing is sent.

tools.name: update_move_status
tools.description: Set the status of one or more moves directly: InTransit when a load is rolling, Completed when it has been delivered, Canceled when the move will not run. Prefer record_stop_actual whenever you know a driver arrived or departed, because that records the stop times and moves the status with them; use this only when the status itself is what you were told. A move only moves forward: New or Assigned to InTransit, Completed or Canceled, and InTransit to Completed or Canceled. Assigning and unassigning are assign_move and unassign_moves, not a status. Several moves change together or not at all.

moveIds.description: The moves to change, by id from get_dispatch_board (moveId) or get_shipment (its moves). One move is the normal case.

status.description: The status to set. Completed releases the move's equipment for the next load; Canceled is final.

policy.condition: Canceling a move ends it for good, so a cancellation is a proposal a person decides; any other status runs once a person approves it.
policy.rationale: Moves a move's status forward inside Trenova, which re-derives its shipment's status and, on completion, releases its equipment; a move never moves back, so it is not undone by running it again.

tools.name: update_order
tools.description: Change an order's customer, owner, PO number, BOL, currency, quoted amount or base amount. Send only what changes. Its status and total follow its shipments and charges and cannot be set here.

baseAmount.description: The base amount before accessorials, as a decimal such as 1250.00. An empty string clears it.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency, such as USD. Defaults to USD.

customerId.description: The customer the order is for, from list_customers. Only an order with no shipments can change customer. Never guess one.

orderId.description: The order to change, from list_orders, get_order or the orderId get_shipment shows. Never guess one.

ownerId.description: The user who owns the order: the person who asked, or an ownerId get_order shows. Never guess one.

quotedAmount.description: What the customer was quoted, as a decimal such as 1250.00. An empty string clears it.

policy.rationale: Edits an order's own fields inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the old values are set back the same way. A changed amount is a money change.

tools.name: update_order_charge
tools.description: Change an order charge's description, amount or payer split. Send only what changes. An invoiced charge cannot be changed; adjust its invoice instead.

allocations.description: The whole new payer split; an empty list bills it all to the order's customer.

amount.description: The share as an amount such as 250.00, when method is Amount.

billToCustomerId.description: The customer who pays this share, from list_customers. Never guess one.

method.description: Whether the share is a percent of the charge or a fixed amount.

percent.description: The share as a percent such as 60, when method is Percent.

amount.description: The new amount, as a decimal such as 150.00.

chargeId.description: The order charge, from the charges get_order lists. Never guess one.

description.description: The new description, in full.

orderId.description: The order, from list_orders, get_order or the orderId get_shipment shows. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes what the customer is billed; nothing is invoiced or sent, and the old amount is set back the same way until it is invoiced.

tools.name: update_recurring_deduction
tools.description: Propose changing a driver's recurring deduction: its amount, cap, schedule, dates or description, or pausing, resuming or completing it. What was already taken or paid stays as it is. Only the values you give change. A person always decides.

amount.description: The amount each time, as a decimal such as 25.00.

deductionId.description: The recurring deduction, from list_recurring_deductions. Never guess one.

description.description: What it is for, as it will read on the driver's statement.

endDate.description: The last day it applies, when it ends. YYYY-MM-DD.

payCodeId.description: The deduction pay code it posts under, from list_pay_codes.

startDate.description: The first day it applies. YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Paused stops it for now; Completed ends it for good.

totalCap.description: The total after which it stops, when there is one.

policy.rationale: Changes money taken from or added to a driver's pay every settlement; only a person agrees it.

tools.name: update_recurring_earning
tools.description: Propose changing a driver's recurring earning: its amount, cap, schedule, dates or description, or pausing, resuming or completing it. What was already taken or paid stays as it is. Only the values you give change. A person always decides.

amount.description: The amount each time, as a decimal such as 25.00.

description.description: What it is for, as it will read on the driver's statement.

earningId.description: The recurring earning, from list_recurring_earnings. Never guess one.

endDate.description: The last day it applies, when it ends. YYYY-MM-DD.

payCodeId.description: The earning pay code it posts under, from list_pay_codes.

startDate.description: The first day it applies. YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Paused stops it for now; Completed ends it for good.

totalCap.description: The total after which it stops, when there is one.

policy.rationale: Changes money taken from or added to a driver's pay every settlement; only a person agrees it.

tools.name: update_recurring_shipment
tools.description: Change a recurring shipment's name, schedule, timezone, dates, limits, blackout days or whether it generates on its own. Send only what changes; an empty endDate removes the end. Pause or resume it with set_recurring_shipment_status.

autoGenerate.description: Create each shipment on schedule without anyone asking. Off, a person generates each one.

blackoutDates.description: Days no shipment is generated, such as holidays.

cronExpression.description: When shipments repeat, as a five-field cron expression read in the series' timezone: "0 8 * * 1-5" is 08:00 every weekday. Take it from what the person or customer asked for.

description.description: Anything a planner should know about it.

endDate.description: The last day shipments may be generated, in the series' timezone. Leave out for no end. YYYY-MM-DD.

exceptionPolicy.description: What a shipment that falls on a blackout day or weekend does: Skip it, or move it to the business day before or after.

leadTimeDays.description: How many days before each pickup its shipment is created.

maxOccurrences.description: Stop after this many shipments. Leave out for no limit.

name.description: What dispatch calls the series, such as "Acme weekday Dallas run".

recurringShipmentId.description: The series to change, from list_recurring_shipments. Never guess one.

skipWeekends.description: Treat Saturday and Sunday like blackout days.

startDate.description: The first day shipments may be generated, in the series' timezone. YYYY-MM-DD.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone the schedule is read in, such as America/Chicago.

policy.rationale: Changes when a series creates shipments inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the old schedule is set back the same way.

tools.name: update_report
tools.description: Change a saved report the person owns: its definition, name, description, category, tags, visibility or default format. Only what you send changes; leave a field out to keep it. To adjust the columns or filters, call describe_report, edit the definition it returns, check the result with preview_report, and send the whole edited definition here — not a fragment. A built-in report has no definitionId; fork_report gives the person a copy of it that this tool can then change.

category.description: Optional area, such as Accounting, Billing, Operations, Fleet, Workforce or Compliance.

defaultFormat.description: The file format a run produces unless one is asked for. Default csv.

definition.description: A report as the report builder saves it, whole: its dataset, columns, filters and sort all go here and nowhere else. Grouping is implied: a dimension column groups, a measure column aggregates. A report with only dimensions lists rows.

charts.description: Optional: {id, type: bar|hbar|line|area|pie|donut|scatter|kpi, title, xColumnId, seriesIds}.

agg.description: Required for a measure; the field must support it.

bucket.description: Groups a date dimension by period.

computed.description: For kind computed: {op: add|subtract|multiply|divide, leftId, rightId} over two other column ids, or leftValue/rightValue for a constant.

id.description: Your own short unique id for the column, such as c1.

ref.description: A field on the dataset, or on a related dataset reached along edges: {"field": "name"} for the dataset's own field, {"path": ["customer"], "field": "name"} for a field one edge away. Edge names and field keys come from describe_report_dataset.

entity.description: The dataset key from list_report_datasets, such as shipment.

filters.description: An object, not a list: {"op": "and", "filters": [conditions]}. For workers whose driver type is OTR: {"op": "and", "filters": [{"ref": {"field": "driverType"}, "operator": "eq", "value": "OTR"}]}. For one related record whose id you know, compare the dataset's own reference key with it, {"field": "customerId"}, not the record's name. Leave it out for no filter.

agg.description: Only inside having: the aggregation to filter on.

param.description: Bind the value to a parameter by name instead of fixing it.

ref.description: A field on the dataset, or on a related dataset reached along edges: {"field": "name"} for the dataset's own field, {"path": ["customer"], "field": "name"} for a field one edge away. Edge names and field keys come from describe_report_dataset.

value.description: The value to compare with: a scalar, a list for in and notin, a number of days for lastndays and nextndays, [from, to] epoch seconds for daterange. Omit when param is set.

groups.description: Nested groups, each the same shape as this one.

having.description: Filters over aggregated measures, the same shape as filters.

parameters.description: Values asked for at run time and bound to filters by param.

definitionId.description: The definitionId of the saved report, from list_reports or describe_report.

description.description: Optional sentence on what the report shows and who it is for.

name.description: The report's name, as it will appear on the Reports page. Say what it answers, such as "Revenue by customer, last 90 days".

status.description: Optional: active runs, draft is kept but hidden from runs, archived retires it. Leave it out to keep the current status.

tags.description: Optional short labels, at most ten.

visibility.description: private keeps the report to the person you are acting for; shared lets everyone in the organization run it. Default private. Do not share unless asked to.

policy.rationale: Changes a saved report colleagues may open; nothing leaves the organization.

tools.name: update_report_schedule
tools.description: Change a report schedule the person set up: when it runs, its zone, the formats, who it is emailed to, or switch it on or off. Fields left out keep their value. The report must exist; list_reports finds its id.

cronExpression.description: When it runs, as five cron fields, such as "0 7 * * 1" for 07:00 every Monday.

definitionId.description: The saved report it runs, from list_reports. Leave it out to keep it.

emailAttach.description: Attach the file rather than only linking to it.

emailInline.description: Put the rows in the email body.

emailRecipients.description: The email addresses it goes to, replacing the list.

scheduleId.description: The schedule, from list_report_schedules. Never guess one.

timezone.description: The zone the schedule is read in, as an IANA name such as America/New_York.

policy.rationale: Changes where and when a report is emailed, which may be to addresses outside the organization.

tools.name: update_safety_violation
tools.description: Correct a roadside violation cited on a safety event: its BASIC, regulation, wording, severity weight or out-of-service flag. Give only what changes.

basic.description: The BASIC it falls under. Leave it out to take what the event implies.

description.description: What was cited, as the inspection report words it.

outOfService.description: Whether this violation put the driver or vehicle out of service.

violationId.description: The violation, from list_worker_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Corrects a cited violation inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: update_service_failure
tools.description: Change the reason code, notes or EDI 214 code overrides on an open or reviewed service failure. Send only what changes; an empty string clears a note or override. It does not move the failure through its lifecycle: use review_service_failure, resolve_service_failure or void_service_failure for that.

clearReasonCode.description: True to remove the reason code. A reviewed failure keeps its reason.

notes.description: What the customer may read about the failure.

reasonCodeId.description: The reason code to set, from list_service_failure_reason_codes.

serviceFailureId.description: The failure, from list_service_failures or the page you are on. Never guess one.

x12ReasonCodeOverride.description: EDI 214 reason code override, three characters.

x12StatusCodeOverride.description: EDI 214 status code override, three characters.

policy.rationale: Edits a service failure's own notes and codes inside Trenova; the overrides shape a later EDI 214, so a person approves each edit.

tools.name: update_shipment
tools.description: Change the details of a saved shipment: the customer, service type, shipment type, equipment types, BOL, pieces, weight or temperature range. Send only the fields to change. Stops, moves, rates and status are not changed here; use the move, hold and cancel tools for those.

bol.description: The customer's BOL or reference number.

customerId.description: The new customer, from list_customers.

pieces.description: The total piece or handling-unit count.

serviceTypeId.description: The new service type, from list_service_types.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to change, from the page, list_shipments or search_shipments.

shipmentTypeId.description: The new shipment type, from list_shipment_types.

tractorTypeId.description: The new tractor equipment type, from list_equipment_types.

trailerTypeId.description: The new trailer equipment type, from list_equipment_types.

policy.rationale: A changed shipment is sent as an EDI tender change to the trading partners it was tendered to.

tools.name: update_shipment_hold
tools.description: Change an active hold on a shipment: its severity, its notes, what it blocks (dispatch, delivery, billing) and whether the customer sees it. Send only what changes; everything else stays as it is. Use release_shipment_hold to clear a hold rather than unblocking everything. Making a hold visible to the customer is shown to them, so only do it when the person asked.

blocksBilling.description: Whether it stops the shipment being billed.

blocksDelivery.description: Whether it stops the shipment being delivered.

blocksDispatch.description: Whether it stops the shipment being dispatched.

holdId.description: The hold to change, from the holds get_shipment lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

notes.description: What the hold waits on, replacing the notes on it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the hold is on, from get_shipment, search_shipments or the page you are on. Never guess one.

visibleToCustomer.description: Whether the customer sees the hold.

policy.rationale: Changes a hold inside Trenova; one made visible to the customer is shown to them, so that call is held to the customer-visible ceiling.

tools.name: update_shipment_permit
tools.description: Correct or move on a permit recorded on a shipment: activate it when the state issues it, fix its number or dates, or void it. Give only what changes. The shipment's permit requirements are worked out again.

cost.description: What the state charged, as a decimal string such as 85.00.

expiresAt.description: When the permit stops covering the move. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

issuedAt.description: When the permit takes effect. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

notes.description: Route conditions, escort or travel-time restrictions the permit carries.

permitId.description: The permit, from list_shipment_permits. Never guess one.

permitNumber.description: The permit number exactly as the state printed it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the permit covers, from get_shipment, search_shipments or the page you are on. Never guess one.

stateId.description: The state that issued it, as the stateId of the requirement it satisfies in list_shipment_permits. Never guess one.

status.description: Where the permit stands. An active permit records when it expires.

policy.rationale: Changes a permit on the shipment inside Trenova, which can place or lift a dispatch hold; nothing is sent to the state, and it is changed again the same way.

tools.name: update_table_change_alert
tools.description: Change one of the person's change alerts: what it watches, which changes, the conditions or its message. Parts left out keep their value.

conditionMatch.description: Whether every condition must hold, or any one. Defaults to all. Leave it out to keep it.

conditions.description: Narrow when it fires: each compares a column (field) to a value, e.g. status changed_to Delayed. is_null, is_not_null and changed take no value. Leave empty to fire on every matching event. Leave it out to keep it.

customMessage.description: What the notification should say. Leave it out to keep it.

eventTypes.description: Which changes to watch: INSERT for a new record, UPDATE for an edit, DELETE for a removal. A status change is an UPDATE. Leave it out to keep it.

name.description: What the alert is called, in the words of the thing watched. Leave it out to keep it.

tableChangeAlertId.description: The alert, from list_table_change_alerts. Never guess one.

tableName.description: The table to watch, e.g. shipments, customers, workers. Leave it out to keep it.

watchedColumns.description: Only fire when one of these columns changed. Leave empty to fire on any change. Leave it out to keep it.

policy.rationale: Changes an alert whose notices go to the person who owns it; nothing else changes.

tools.name: update_tractor
tools.description: Change a tractor: its driver, team driver, equipment type, fleet, make, model, VIN, plate, registration or fuel. Fields left out keep their value. Use update_tractor_status for many units and locate_tractor to move one.

code.description: The unit number, unique in this organization. Leave it out to keep it.

equipmentManufacturerId.description: Who made it, from list_equipment_manufacturers. Leave it out to keep it.

equipmentTypeId.description: Its equipment type, from list_equipment_types. Leave it out to keep it.

externalId.description: Its id in another system, such as a telematics provider. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

fleetCodeId.description: The fleet it belongs to, from list_fleet_codes. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

fuelType.description: The fuel it burns; its miles land on this fuel's lines of an IFTA return. Defaults to Diesel. Leave it out to keep it.

iftaQualified.description: Whether its miles and fuel enter the IFTA return. Defaults to true. Leave it out to keep it.

licensePlateNumber.description: The license plate. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

make.description: The make. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

model.description: The model. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

primaryWorkerId.description: The driver who runs it, from search_worker or list_workers. Leave it out to keep it.

registrationExpiry.description: When the registration expires. A date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

registrationNumber.description: The registration number. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

secondaryWorkerId.description: A team driver, from search_worker or list_workers. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

state.description: The state it is registered in. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

status.description: Whether it can be dispatched. Available means it can be dispatched. OutOfService means it cannot, for any reason other than scheduled work. AtMaintenance means it is in the shop. Sold means it has left the fleet and is not coming back. Defaults to Available. Leave it out to keep it.

tractorId.description: The tractor to change, from list_tractors. Never guess one.

vin.description: The 17-character VIN. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

year.description: The model year. Leave it out to keep it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a tractor inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a later change puts it back.

tools.name: update_tractor_status
tools.description: Change the status of one or more tractors, which is what makes a truck available to dispatch or takes it off the board. Available means it can be dispatched. OutOfService means it cannot, for any reason other than scheduled work. AtMaintenance means it is in the shop. Sold means it has left the fleet and is not coming back. Get the ids from list_tractors; a unit number is not an id.

status.description: The status to set. Available means it can be dispatched. OutOfService means it cannot, for any reason other than scheduled work. AtMaintenance means it is in the shop. Sold means it has left the fleet and is not coming back.

tractorIds.description: The tractors to move, by id from list_tractors. One id is the normal case.

policy.rationale: Changes a tractor's status inside Trenova.

tools.name: update_trailer
tools.description: Change a trailer: its equipment type, fleet, make, model, VIN, plate, registration, load limit or last inspection. Fields left out keep their value. Use update_trailer_status for many units and locate_trailer to move one.

code.description: The unit number, unique in this organization. Leave it out to keep it.

equipmentManufacturerId.description: Who made it, from list_equipment_manufacturers. Leave it out to keep it.

equipmentTypeId.description: Its equipment type, from list_equipment_types. Leave it out to keep it.

externalId.description: Its id in another system, such as a telematics provider. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

fleetCodeId.description: The fleet it belongs to, from list_fleet_codes. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

lastInspectionDate.description: When it was last inspected. A date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

licensePlateNumber.description: The license plate. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

make.description: The make. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

maxLoadWeight.description: The most it may carry, in pounds. Leave it out to keep it.

model.description: The model. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

registrationExpiry.description: When the registration expires. A date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

registrationNumber.description: The registration number. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

registrationState.description: The state it is registered in. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

status.description: Whether it can be dispatched. Available means it can be dispatched. OutOfService means it cannot, for any reason other than scheduled work. AtMaintenance means it is in the shop. Sold means it has left the fleet and is not coming back. Defaults to Available. Leave it out to keep it.

trailerId.description: The trailer to change, from list_trailers. Never guess one.

vin.description: The 17-character VIN. Leave it out to keep it. Send an empty value to clear it.

year.description: The model year. Leave it out to keep it.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Changes a trailer inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a later change puts it back.

tools.name: update_trailer_status
tools.description: Change the status of one or more trailers, which is what makes a trailer available to dispatch or takes it off the board. Available means it can be dispatched. OutOfService means it cannot, for any reason other than scheduled work. AtMaintenance means it is in the shop. Sold means it has left the fleet and is not coming back. Get the ids from list_trailers; a unit number is not an id.

status.description: The status to set. Available means it can be dispatched. OutOfService means it cannot, for any reason other than scheduled work. AtMaintenance means it is in the shop. Sold means it has left the fleet and is not coming back.

trailerIds.description: The trailers to move, by id from list_trailers. One id is the normal case.

policy.rationale: Changes a trailer's status inside Trenova.

tools.name: update_worker_checklist_item
tools.description: Settle or reopen one item on a worker's open checklist. Complete it when it is done, with a document as evidence when there is one; Skip or NotApplicable with a note saying why; or Reopen a settled item. A checklist whose required items are all settled closes on its own.

checklistItemId.description: The item, from list_worker_checklists. Never guess one.

evidenceDocumentId.description: For Complete: a document filed on the worker that shows it done, from search_documents.

note.description: What was done, or why it was skipped or does not apply. Required to skip or mark not applicable.

policy.rationale: Settles or reopens a checklist item inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a settled item is reopened the same way.

tools.name: update_worker_credential
tools.description: Correct a credential on file: its number, issuer, dates, document or notes. Give only what changes. Changing a fact a person verified clears the verification. An archived credential is read-only; record a new one instead.

credentialId.description: The credential, from list_worker_credentials or list_expiring_credentials. Never guess one.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from search_documents. Never guess one.

expiresAt.description: When it expires. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

issuedAt.description: When it was issued. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

issuingAuthority.description: Who issued it, such as the state.

notes.description: Anything the credential should say.

number.description: The number on the card or certificate, exactly as printed.

policy.rationale: Corrects a credential inside Trenova, which can change whether the worker may be dispatched; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: update_worker_injury
tools.description: Correct or bring up to date an injury case: its classification, treatment, days away or restricted, return to work, the claim, or close it. Give only what changes. The log must stay accurate for five years after its year, so a closed case is still corrected.

bodyPart.description: The part of the body affected.

claimClosedAt.description: When the claim closed. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

claimFiledAt.description: When the claim was filed. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

claimStatus.description: Where the workers' comp claim stands.
