classification.description: How the case is classified on the OSHA 300 log. Recordability is the employer's judgement: leave it out unless a person gave it, and the case takes the classification the treatment suggests.

daysAway.description: Days away from work, capped at 180 as the log counts them.

daysRestricted.description: Days on restricted duty or job transfer.

description.description: What happened and the injury.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from search_documents. Never guess one.

harmfulAgent.description: What harmed the worker, such as a load strap.

illnessType.description: Injury, or the kind of illness.

injuryId.description: The injury case, from list_worker_injuries. Never guess one.

notes.description: Anything the case should say.

occurredAt.description: When it happened. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

privacyCase.description: Whether the worker's name is withheld from the log as a privacy case.

reportedAt.description: When the worker reported it. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

returnedToWorkAt.description: When the worker came back to work. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

safetyEventId.description: The accident it came from, from list_worker_safety_events.

status.description: Open or Closed.

policy.rationale: Corrects a case on the OSHA log inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: update_worker_pto
tools.description: Change the kind, days or reason of a time-off request still waiting for a decision. Give only what changes. A decided request is refused; cancel it and file another.

endDate.description: The last day off. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

ptoId.description: The id of the time-off request, from list_time_off. A worker id is not a request id.

reason.description: The reason the worker gave. The driver sees it with the request.

startDate.description: The first day off. YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day.

policy.rationale: Changes a pending request the driver sees in Dash; it is changed again the same way.

tools.name: update_worker_safety_event
tools.description: Correct a safety event on a driver's record: what happened, when, the points it carries, the inspection result, the fine or cost. Give only what changes. It never moves the event's status; change_worker_safety_event_status does.

costAmount.description: What it cost the company, as a decimal such as 1800.00.

description.description: What happened, in the words of the report or the person who told you.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from search_documents. Never guess one.

fineAmount.description: A fine, as a decimal such as 250.00.

inspectionLevel.description: For an inspection: its CVSA level.

inspectionResult.description: For an inspection: how it ended.

occurredAt.description: When it happened. An ISO 8601 date and time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

outOfService.description: Whether the driver or the vehicle was put out of service.

points.description: The points it carries on the driver's record. Leave it out on a new event to take the house scale for the kind and severity.

preventable.description: For an accident: whether it was preventable. Leave it out unless the report says so.

referenceNumber.description: A citation, report or inspection number.

resolution.description: How it was resolved, kept on the event.

safetyEventId.description: The safety event, from list_worker_safety_events. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The load it happened on, from search_shipments or get_shipment. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Corrects an event on a driver's safety record inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the event is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: verify_carrier_equipment
tools.description: Check that the truck or trailer a carrier sent for a load is registered to that carrier, by VIN or plate, and record the answer on the assignment. Take the numbers from the driver or the carrier's dispatch, never from a guess.

carrierAssignmentId.description: The carrier assignment, from list_rate_confirmations or get_shipment. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Records an equipment check inside Trenova after a provider lookup; nothing is sent to the carrier.

tools.name: vet_carrier
tools.description: Look a carrier up with the organization's carrier intelligence provider now: authority, insurance, safety and the organization's rules, recorded on the carrier. Use it before tendering to a carrier nobody has checked lately. A result still current is reused unless force is true.

carrierId.description: The carrier, from list_carriers or get_carrier. Never guess one.

depth.description: How deep a lookup: FMCSA is the public record, Lite and Full add the provider's profile. Defaults to Full.

force.description: Look up again even when the last result is still current. It is charged; only when the person asks.

policy.rationale: Spends the organization's carrier intelligence budget on a lookup and records the result; nothing is sent to the carrier.

tools.name: vet_customer_broker
tools.description: Check a customer that is a freight broker against the public FMCSA record by its DOT number: broker authority and bond. Use it before taking freight from a broker nobody has checked lately.

customerId.description: The broker customer, from list_customers. Never guess one.

force.description: Look up again even when the last result is still current. It is charged; only when the person asks.

policy.rationale: Spends the organization's carrier intelligence budget on a lookup and records the result; nothing is sent to the customer.

tools.name: void_carrier_settlement
tools.description: Propose voiding a carrier settlement that is not yet paid, with the reason. A posted one has its journal entry reversed. Its pay returns to the pool to be settled again, so a person always decides.

reason.description: Why it must not be paid, such as a duplicate of another settlement.

settlementId.description: The carrier settlement, from list_carrier_settlements or get_carrier_settlement or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Cancels a settlement for good and reverses any posting; only a person voids.

tools.name: void_driver_settlement
tools.description: Propose voiding a driver settlement that is not yet paid, with the reason. A posted one has its journal entry reversed. Its pay returns to the pool to be settled again, so a person always decides.

reason.description: Why it must not be paid, such as a duplicate of another settlement.

settlementId.description: The driver settlement, from list_driver_settlements or get_driver_settlement or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Cancels a settlement for good and reverses any posting; only a person voids.

tools.name: void_invoice
tools.description: Propose voiding an invoice. A draft is voided in place; a posted one through a full-reversal adjustment that credits it, which may wait for an approver. Its freight is rebilled or canceled as you say. Unapply payments and credits first. A person always decides.

disposition.description: Rebill puts its freight back on the billing queue to be billed again; DoNotRebill cancels it.

invoiceId.description: The invoice, from list_invoices or get_invoice. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why it is voided; kept on the invoice.

policy.rationale: Takes an invoice out of circulation and reverses what it booked; it cannot be undone, so only a person voids one.

tools.name: void_payroll_export
tools.description: Draft voiding a payroll run for a person to approve, with the reason: the run is taken back and every week in it returns to approved, ready for another run. A run already voided is refused.

payrollExportId.description: The payroll run, from list_payroll_exports. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why the run is voided, kept on it.

policy.rationale: Takes back a payroll run that payroll may already have paid from, so a person approves it and it runs as them; a voided run stays voided.

tools.name: void_rate_confirmation
tools.description: Void a rate confirmation so the revision stops standing and its sign link stops working. Voiding one the carrier confirmed returns their assignment to awaiting confirmation. Use it when the agreement as written is wrong and should not be signed; to correct it, generate a new revision instead, which voids this one. Say why in reason. Find the revision with list_rate_confirmations.

rateConfirmationId.description: The revision to void, from list_rate_confirmations.

reason.description: Why the agreement is withdrawn, in a sentence a person can check.

policy.condition: A revision the carrier has been sent or has signed is voided only as a proposal a person decides, as is one that cannot be read; one never sent is voided once a person approves it.
policy.rationale: Withdraws the organization's written agreement to pay a carrier, whose sign link stops working, and undoes a confirmation it carried; a voided revision cannot be restored, only replaced.

tools.name: void_service_failure
tools.description: Void a service failure that should never have been opened, with the reason why: a wrong appointment window, a corrected arrival, a stop that was not late. Voiding is final. For a failure that was real and is now handled, use resolve_service_failure instead.

notes.description: What was found, in a sentence a person reads on the failure later.

serviceFailureId.description: The failure, from list_service_failures or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Voiding a failure is final and may send an EDI 214 to the customer's trading partner; only a person approves it.

tools.name: waive_detention
tools.description: Waive a detention charge, with a coded reason and a note. This gives up revenue, so propose it only when the cause is plainly the carrier's own (a late truck, an equipment problem), the weather, or a data correction, and say why in the note. A person decides.

note.description: Why, in a sentence a person can read on the occurrence later.

reason.description: The coded reason for the waiver.

policy.rationale: Gives up detention revenue the organization would otherwise bill; only a person approves it.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read the text of a page that web_search returned, to check details its short passages left out. Takes the result's url and ref exactly as web_search gave them; it cannot open any other address. Long pages come in parts of about 8,000 characters. Cite what you use by linking to it.

part.description: Optional: which part of a long page to read, starting at 1. Ask for the next part only when the previous one said the page continues.

ref.description: The ref web_search returned with that url, copied exactly.

url.description: The page's url, copied exactly from a web_search result.

policy.rationale: Reads a page a web search returned; it changes nothing in Trenova and returns text written outside it.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web for current information that is not in Trenova, such as regulations, agency guidance and industry news. Returns pages with short passages, government sites first and marked official. Use it for rules and facts outside the organization's own records instead of answering from memory, which may be out of date. The query leaves Trenova: never put record IDs, email addresses, phone numbers or private details about a customer, carrier or driver in it. Cite what you use by linking to it.

limit.description: Optional: how many pages to return, at most the organization's setting.

publishedWithinDays.description: Optional: only pages published in the last this many days, for news or recent rule changes. Leave it out for standing rules.

query.description: What to look up, in plain words, such as "FMCSA ELD malfunction rules" or "IFTA quarterly filing deadlines". General terms only.

policy.rationale: Searches the public web through the organization's extension; it changes nothing in Trenova, sends only the query, and returns text written outside it.

tools.name: withdraw_invoice_dispute
tools.description: Withdraw an open invoice dispute the customer no longer pursues, without recording an outcome. The invoice's Disputed flag clears and it goes back to collections as it was. Use resolve_invoice_dispute instead when there is an outcome to record.

disputeId.description: The open dispute, from list_invoice_disputes. Never guess one.

notes.description: Why the customer dropped it.

policy.taintHold: A withdrawal read from what a customer wrote is proposed, since it sends the invoice back to collections.
policy.rationale: Closes a dispute case inside Trenova with no outcome; it moves no money and a new case can be opened with open_invoice_dispute.

tools.name: withdraw_shift_swap
tools.description: Withdraw a shift swap on the proposing worker's behalf, when they told the office they no longer want it.

note.description: What the workers are told about it.

swapId.description: The swap, from get_worker_schedule. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Takes back a request the workers read in their portal; a person approves each withdrawal.

tools.name: write_off_pay_advance
tools.description: Propose writing off what is still owed on a driver's pay advance, so no more is recovered from their pay, with the reason. The organization absorbs the loss, so a person always decides; use it when the advance cannot be recovered, such as a driver who has left.

advanceId.description: The advance, from list_pay_advances. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why it cannot be recovered.

policy.rationale: Forgives money a driver owes, which the organization absorbs; only a person writes it off.
